title: Rosalind and the Orbit
author: Odile Montrose
blurb: Petra Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
